rule: One hit in order: down check; block or jump-back check; side from attacker bearing; perception and cancel of victim queued move (onTakeHit) with AI wait zero; damage value; impact sound and particle (before HP write); interrupt and stumble A/B unless FLY; FLY launches a fall with speed 0.75 and vertical share 0.5; HP written last; 50 percent victim voice; knockout sets HP to 1 and drops weapon, shield and torch. Script screen effects (time.slw, screenblend.scx, morph.fov, earthquake.eqk) are not on the hit path.
keep: Cancel the victim's queued move on hit, and zero its AI wait so it re-decides at once
Impact sound and particle from a keyed table with fallbacks (weapon material, armour material, scheme, then family default)
Stumble side from the attacker's bearing (two clips, A or B)
Fall vector from the blow with a fixed speed and a vertical share
HP is written last in the hit, after the feedback has been decided and started
Victim groan on a random share of hits, never when already down
change: No time scaling in the engine; any hit-stop is a client-only pose pause and the server tick never pauses
Screen blend and quake are client-only and use our own colours and clamps
Cap concurrent impact puffs per victim at 3 for many-vs-one
Keep the impact decision in src/fight and present it on the client
look_test: Style flag on the existing fight scene with light, blocked and heavy hits; stumble side from attacker bearing, cancelled counter, a 60 ms client-only pause on heavy only, 50 percent groan. Compare on a 375 wide phone with the flag off. Target src/fight/hit-impact.ts, row 10. No release rows, no lock; Deploy publishes to /preview/.
